skills.name: query-and-analyze
skills.description: Queries connections, joins results across sources through DuckDB, and analyzes workspace data. Use this skill whenever the user wants to look at, count, summarize, filter, group, join, aggregate, compare, or analyze data, or when exploring a connection's schema or doing follow-up analysis on a previous query.
headings: Step 4 — Inspect schema and existing queries
Step 7 — Analyze and join through DuckDB
Step 8 — Export large results for the user
Work with files in the remote workspace
skills.description_zh: 查询MarcoPolo数据连接，通过DuckDB跨来源连接结果，探索模式并筛选、分组、聚合、比较和分析工作区数据，支持先前查询的后续分析。

skills.name: setup-connection
skills.description: Adds a new connection to the MarcoPolo workspace — hosted demo connections (no credentials) and credentialed connections to databases, warehouses, APIs, and storage (Postgres, Snowflake, BigQuery, Salesforce, S3, Google Drive, etc.). Use this skill whenever the user mentions adding, connecting, installing, hooking up, or wiring up a datasource — even when they describe it informally ("connect my Snowflake", "try the demo data", "let me hook up our Salesforce", "I want to look at the data in S3"). Also use when troubleshooting `connection test` failures, expired credentials, or an OAuth flow that didn't finish.
headings: Path A — install a hosted demo connection
Path B — add a credentialed connection
skills.description_zh: 向MarcoPolo添加无需凭据的托管演示或数据库、仓库、API、存储凭据连接，涵盖Postgres、Snowflake、BigQuery、Salesforce、S3和Drive，并排查连接测试、过期凭据与OAuth未完成。

skills.name: using-connection-cli
skills.description: Reference for the in-workspace `connection` CLI — verb shape, JSON envelope, the capability rule, and per-verb flag details. Use this skill whenever any `connection` verb (`list`, `add`, `test`, `describe`, `query`, `browse`, `download`, `upload`) is about to run, when looking up flags, when checking whether a verb is allowed by a connection's capabilities, or when reading the JSON response. Consult it even for routine commands — guessing flag names or capability-gating leads to wasted work and surprising failures.
skills.description_zh: 提供MarcoPolo工作区connection CLI参考，说明命令结构、JSON响应、能力规则及各命令参数，涵盖list、add、test、describe、query、browse、download和upload。

skills.name: using-marcopolo-workspace
skills.description: Orientation for the MarcoPolo remote workspace, what it is, how `/workspace` is laid out, when to use the product MCP data tools versus `workspace_shell`, and how the `connection` CLI fits in. Use this skill whenever MarcoPolo, the marcopolo MCP server, `workspace_shell`, `/workspace`, connections, or `connection` CLI commands come up. Read this first when entering a MarcoPolo session, before reaching for a more specific skill.
headings: The `connection` CLI is the workspace verb surface
skills.description_zh: 介绍MarcoPolo远程工作区布局、产品MCP数据工具与workspace_shell的选择，以及connection CLI的位置，作为进入工作区会话的先行导览。
